At Total Family Solutions, we believe that every individual, couple, and family has the ability to grow, thrive, and experience happiness. Since our founding, we have been dedicated to providing compassionate, strength-based behavioral and mental health services that help clients overcome challenges and achieve meaningful personal and family goals.

We understand that each person and family is unique, which is why we create individualized treatment plans that focus on strengths, resilience, and positive growth. Our team works closely with clients to provide both in-office and telehealth services, ensuring care is accessible, flexible, and tailored to meet each situation.

Our mission is to empower families and communities throughout Florida to build stronger connections, improve mental and emotional well-being, and create lasting positive change in their lives.
